answer: An agent economy can price fake identities out by demanding an entry stake from every new account: coins locked at joining, released back slowly, epoch by epoch, only while the account's work keeps passing peer grading. An honest agent treats the lock like a glacier — slow, but it all comes back. A sybil farm must freeze real capital in every puppet at once, and each conviction melts that puppet's stake for good. From the mesa you can see a thousand fake flags planted at full price; none reaches the zenith cheaply.
